infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: S2RB discovers S2 AIOS hosts and silicon agents on the same Wi-Fi. Topology stays on this device.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: S2RB scans the pairing QR code of a local S2 AIOS host.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: S2RB may sample ambient noise for Red Anchor safety assessment. Audio never leaves this device.
